name: Crunches
variation: Supine bent-knee abdominal crunch with hands lightly behind head; no sit-up or neck pull.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter, head left and feet right, slight elevation shows both arms and both planted shoes.

muscles.note: Qualitative visible hierarchy. Catalogue hip flexors are deep and are not drawn through the body.

frames.label: Set and brace
frames.cue: Plant feet; rest hands lightly behind head.
frames.state: Back and shoulder blades resting on floor, knees bent, feet flat, hands lightly supporting head.

frames.label: Begin curl
frames.cue: Curl your shoulders up using your abs.
frames.state: Shoulder blades beginning to lift, ribs moving toward pelvis; head follows torso, elbows open.

frames.label: Lift shoulders
frames.cue: Lift shoulder blades; keep lower back down.
frames.state: Small crunch peak with shoulder blades clear; lower back and pelvis stay grounded; no sit-up.

frames.label: Pause briefly
frames.cue: Pause without pulling on your neck.

frames.label: Lower slowly
frames.cue: Lower your shoulders slowly with control.
frames.state: Controlled return through the intermediate curl.

frames.label: Return to floor
frames.cue: Rest shoulders; keep your feet planted.
frames.state: Shoulder blades return to floor; no foot or pelvis displacement.
